summary.text: Skyler Wheeler is a Republican state representative who has represented Iowa House District 4 since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In the 2025-2026 session Wheeler chairs the House Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Skyler Wheeler assumed office in the Iowa House on January 1, 2017, and advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026, according to Ballotpedia.
In the 2025-2026 session Wheeler was assigned to the House Education Committee as chair, along with the House Judiciary and House Local Government committees.
